name: Kongamato
description: A reported flying creature of the swamps of north-western Zambia, eastern Angola, and the southern Democratic Republic of the Congo, said by Kaonde and Lunda informants to attack boats and inflict severe wounds, and frequently described in cryptozoological literature as resembling a pterosaur — a long-beaked, leathery-winged, toothed flying reptile.

aliases.name: Olitiau
aliases.meaning: another African pterosaur-like cryptid sometimes grouped with the kongamato in cryptozoological literature

origin: North-western Zambia (Mwinilunga District and adjacent swamps), the Bangweulu wetlands of north-eastern Zambia, eastern Angola, and the southern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with secondary reports from Zimbabwe and Cameroon (where similar cryptids are reported under other names).
